visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man and a woman are in a close embrace in a dimly lit room with a beige wall featuring a drawing of a tree branch. The woman wears a white fuzzy robe and has her eyes closed, appearing emotional; the man has short dark hair and a grey t-shirt. (2) The scene shifts to a bright, modern airport or station interior with a 'BIJANKA' sign. The woman is smiling and walking, wearing a floral dress and a headband. (3) Indoors, the woman, now with very long hair in a braid, tearfully hugs an older man and woman near a wooden door and tiled wall. (4) The woman sits in a home environment, wearing a beige cardigan over a grey shirt, dabbing her eyes with a white tissue while looking distressed. (5) On a train platform outdoors on a grey day, the woman in a black coat and beanie talks to an older man in a yellow jacket while holding a large black suitcase. (6) The woman boards a yellow and green train, kissing the older man goodbye before the doors close. (7) Inside the train, she sits on a green seat, continuously crying and wiping her face with tissues. Yellow subtitles appear throughout.
